sh:
Use case: identity-preserve. Animation correction, game walking sprites.
Reference image 1 supplies ONLY the exact student's identity, yellow hoodie, short black hair, clothing, colors, softly shaded fine pixel-chibi style and 2.6-head-tall body proportions. Redraw ONLY walking animations for this same student.
Output: EXACTLY 18 full-body sprites, SIX COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, equally sized cells. Prefer 1536x768. No props, labels, scenery, ground shadows, borders or grid. Actual transparent PNG background. Preserve clear dark character outlines. No painted background.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: The reference walk has too many identical WIDE-STRIDE silhouettes. The new gait MUST clearly alternate WIDE → NARROW → NARROW → WIDE → NARROW → NARROW. At least FOUR frames per row have feet close together directly beneath the hips. Do not repeat the reference's continuous wide stride.
COLUMNS, repeated in each row:
1. Contact: near leg straight forward, far leg back. A clearly wide stride.
2. Passing: supporting foot planted directly UNDER THE HIPS; other foot lifted next to the supporting ankle. Legs almost together, NARROW silhouette.
3. Up: supporting foot still directly UNDER THE HIPS; opposite knee slightly forward and lifted, feet still CLOSE together, NARROW silhouette.
4. Opposite contact: far leg now straight forward, near leg back. The OTHER leg leads, a clearly wide stride. Opposite arms to frame 1.
5. Opposite passing: foot planted UNDER THE HIPS, the OTHER foot lifted beside supporting ankle. Legs almost together, NARROW silhouette.
6. Opposite up: supporting foot UNDER THE HIPS, the OTHER knee lifted slightly, feet CLOSE together, NARROW silhouette.
ROW 1: right-facing PROFILE throughout, genuine alternating near/far legs. Swing arms oppositely to legs. Front foot and back foot exchange on column 4. HEAD AND TORSO STAY OVER HIPS.
ROW 2: front view walking TOWARD the camera, same six phases, forward shoe sole/raised knee alternate left and right.
ROW 3: back view walking AWAY from camera, back of head and outfit visible, no face, same alternating six phases.
Keep head size, face, hairstyle and outfit identical. All frames use the same body scale, horizontal body center, and ground baseline. Small vertical head bob is welcome. Feet and all hair fit entirely in their cells. Smoothly loop each row with a readable relaxed walking rhythm.
